text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Oh no, night has completely 
fallen...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
But... yeah. That covers everything in our 
cleaning area.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, I need to get back and report 
to the Beautification Committee 
Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our summer training camp with Air Messiah 
was finally reaching its climax. Though 
there were twists and turns, we were now 
able to train with clear and positive 
minds.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Growth has been steady leading into the 
main autumn races. ...However, pushing too 
hard without a break won't do either! And 
so—!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yaaay☆ Time for clam digging~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Come on, you too, Trainer-san! Yaaaay☆

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please don't overdo it... 
Everyone, I look forward to working with 
you today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please take care of me! By the way, 
they said the beach hut will cook the 
shellfish we gather for us!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? Alright, let's make dinner 
super-duper extravagant tonight!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Just you wait, clam jerk, littleneck 
jerk... and... and a bunch of other 
stuff!!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
All right... I've got a hunch it's this 
way! Follow me, everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, Pokke-chan!? Umm... let's go too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Pokke-san has incredible momentum~! 
Is that wild instinct tingling at full 
blast?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I can't quite grasp the logic, but... For 
now, let's follow along so we don't get 
separated."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: You as well, Trainer. Let's enjoy today.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Taking a break is important too, huh

Yeah. Taking a breather is important too, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let us continue to cherish it. 
...Just as we always have.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One of the recreational activities 
prepared for summer training camp was clam 
digging.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I decided to have a blast with Air 
Messiah and the other Umamusume who had 
signed up for clam digging!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see~, I heard from Cheval-chi! 
First you gotta look for little holes in 
the sand, right?☆

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because it's very likely that clams 
underneath are extending their siphons to 
breathe.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I wanna try catching one of those! 
What're they called again? Those super 
long, skinny guys.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Long and slender, you say...? Ah, could it 
be razor clams?
choice_data_list: Then... maybe we need some salt.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Salt?! Wait, what're you using that for?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
These clams are sensitive to salinity 
levels in their surroundings. Apparently, 
it's common practice to pour salt into 
their burrows and catch them when they pop 
out.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh~, sounds like fun!! Alright, I'm gonna 
go borrow some salt from the lodge!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Pocket-senpai, everything's ready! 
Please look for the bag in the shade of 
the tree over there.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You had one!? Thank you so much~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible...! Both you and your Trainer 
are so knowledgeable, Messiah-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Could it be that both of you are quite 
experienced at clam digging?
choice_data_list: No, it's not particularly like that...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However, since it was known 
beforehand that the recreational activity 
would be clam digging—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our eyes suddenly meet, and we nod in 
unison. If we had known that in advance, 
there was only one thing to do.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Hmm, this page is also very informative.
choice_data_list: Could you send me the URL?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm back. I've got a pretty good 
grasp of the general idea, and—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll try digging a little deeper 
into gear and equipment.
choice_data_list:
Then I'll share some tips for each kind of 
shellfish...

Then I'll share some tips for each kind of 
shellfish...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...?! So in other words, you two 
did an incredible amount of 'prep work' 
for this...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I suppose that would be the case. Even if 
it is just a makeshift solution without 
the experience to back it up—
choice_data_list:
If I'm being helpful to everyone, that 
makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, absolutely! It's been a huge help, 
but...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, that's amazing. I want to follow 
both of your examples!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, everyone enjoyed clam 
digging. In the end, we managed quite a 
massive haul—

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, thanks for waiting! 
Butter-sauteed razor clams, fresh and 
ready~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much~!! Eek~! Smells super 
good~♡

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Clerk
text_block_list.text:
The clams should be finished purging sand 
soon, so I'll make sake-steamed clams for 
you. Just wait a little longer, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I'm so excited...!! Thank you so much 
for cooking all of this!

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! After all, you girls worked so 
hard and brought back so much.

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, that was a huge harvest, wasn't 
it! I was really surprised.

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy hosts a clam digging 
recreational trip every year, but... I 
don't think they've ever harvested this 
much before.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh! ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"Well, when clam digging, you often work 
hard to dig something up only for it to be 
trash, after all."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Trash... Ah! Come to think of it, the 
beautification committee was picking up 
trash on the beach just yesterday—!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー! Then, then, it's all thanks to the 
beautification committee, Mejiro-senpai 
and the others~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I didn't see a single piece of trash! As 
expected of Messiah-san♡

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, I only cleaned the area I was assigned 
to.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...However, I'll be sure to tell the 
other committee members that you liked it. 
Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...She laughs it off easily, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, Jungle Pocket, who had appeared 
beside me without me noticing, muttered 
softly, her voice a stark contrast to her 
daytime self.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you say ‘assigned area,’ isn't 
that tough? I mean, it's way too huge—it's 
a whole beach!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You gotta draw the line somewhere, or 
there'll be no end to it. Like, "I picked 
up all the trash I could see," or "all the 
big pieces are gone."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I've done something similar with the 
folks on my old team, and honestly, that's 
pretty standard."
choice_data_list:
...Still, Messiah isn't the kind of girl 
to do that.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha!! You're the same way, so you get it, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Guess so. You did it 'cause it was what 
needed to be done, right? Cleaning up 
every single corner of that endless beach 
trash.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...As head of a street racer crew, I've 
clashed with all kinds of folks, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the day, guys like you are 
honestly the scariest.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"The ones who ‘just do it’... Man, they're 
seriously strong."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. It seems the clam pasta is ready 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a rich menu we have. Everyone 
seems to be having such a wonderful time.
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's eat a lot and build up our 
strength!

At this point, let's put our all into it 
and have a blast!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, as long as it doesn't affect your 
weight.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it's great that it ended up 
being such a fruitful haul.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
As a Beautification Committee member, I 
believed I should thoroughly finish 
cleaning my assigned area... That was part 
of my reasoning, of course, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
From our preliminary research, we already 
knew that establishing a proper 
environment would lead to good results.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Um. In short—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I was really looking forward to today. 
...In my own way, very much so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching warmly as Jungle Pocket and the 
others frolicked and made a racket, Air 
Messiah smiled with deep satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Spirit... is it? What exactly do you mean 
by—
choice_data_list: I... I made sure to prepare one!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Trainer? ...Oh my, could that be—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Aaalright, next up I'm dual-wielding, 
dual-wielding! Vivlos, gimme that one! The 
pink one!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, no way! I'm about to take a picture 
of drawing a big heart with this right 
now~♡

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Pocket-senpai, please hold sparklers one 
at a time for safety. And Viblos-san, no 
swinging them around either.

text_block_list.name: Pocket & Verxina
text_block_list.text: Okaaay...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! With Messiah-chan around, safety 
management is practically flawless...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um, Top Road-senpai too. I watched it, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I think it would be better to hold the 
firework a few more centimeters away from 
your body.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh! Ah!! Y-Yes, I'm so sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Regardless, a very safe and enjoyable 
time was had by all.
